## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] Python tests and configured quality checks pass.
- [ ] Frontend lint and build pass when frontend code is affected.
- [ ] Tests characterize or verify changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when setup or behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, local configuration, generated output, databases, or environments are included.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and security impact were considered.
